teacher_info.introduction:
I’m an American professional TEFL teacher, currently living in China. My teaching has mainly been at International Schools in Shanghai, since 2007. I hold a 120-hour teacher training qualification from INTESOL. 

As a native English speaker from the Midwest of the US, my most valued skills are accent improvement and current vocabulary/word usage. My long work experience in a business/accounting environment is helpful for learning business English. 

Now you are searching for your perfect language tutor on italki, so it seems you have already decided that the miracle of free online 1-to-1 video communication is the best way to meet that goal. Agreed! For learning a language, there is nothing better than private classes; I call it an ‘academically intimate’ atmosphere. 

I bring to each private class years of experience with helping students get the best results from this ideal learning environment. This includes other useful resources available online – my favorite is an excellent ESL Placement Test: https://www.off2class.com/placement. 

The test is our first step; it’s important because it enables us to very accurately evaluate your current strengths and weaknesses. Then we can agree on a perfectly tailored learning path, without the guesswork and stiff one-size-fits-all book methods you might otherwise get stuck with. No time wasted on studying lessons you don’t need, and more time for the satisfaction (and fun!) of breaking through barriers that stopped you before. 

During our classes together, we have access to a huge library of lively (PowerPoint-style) ESL Lesson Plans, which I will often use as a framework for your personalized lessons. Beginner, intermediate, advanced – plenty of lessons and topics for every level. All basic skills are covered: speaking, reading, listening, writing. There are also many lessons devoted to business English, idioms, test preparation (TOEFL, IELTS), and lots more. See https://www.off2class.com/teacher/ Let’s get started today!

pro_course_detail.description:
Naturally, a 'tailored' course is flexible. During our first meeting, I will listen to your English speech skills and habits, offer some informal testing, and access your communication strengths and weaknesses, compared with native and non-native English speakers. I will listen to your own assessment, too, and address any requests you might have, such as accent improvement, vocabulary enhancement, etc. We will discuss my recommendations, and make an agreement for an effective study routine, tailored to your needs.
Also, a special offer to students who book classes with me more frequently: If you complete a full package of 10 classes within 30 days, I will give you 1 extra class, same length, no charge. That’s an additional 9% discount, substantially reducing the cost per lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: CV and Presentation Proofreading/Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Your academic or professional experience can shine through and create a great impression of your talent and abilities, even if your English writing and speaking isn’t perfect. But if your errors are too serious, you risk giving the impression that communication with you could be problematic.

My knowledge of formal English writing, and experience with editing is more than sufficient to take your written work well beyond the ‘adequate’ level (Candidly, it’s no exaggeration to say that any capable editor can easily make it flawless, and sparkle like a jewel!) However, more modest improvements are often a wiser choice, to match the level of your conversational (and presentational) English skills. As we review and revise your written information together, your ability to express this information verbally (speaking and conversing) will naturally grow. You will find I am well prepared to guide this process – recognizing where my patience as a teacher is necessary, because the expression of such information may become quite complex.

pro_course_detail.title: American English Pronunciation Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we may work on pronunciation through:
~ dialogues (beginner through advanced)
~ working through a comprehensive guide on American English (book can be bought by student if desired)
~ listening to videos (advanced)
~ listening to songs (elementary through advanced)

Students will learn about:
~ American vowels, word stress, rhythm, consonants, intonation
~ pronunciation of phrases in connected speech

I'm a native English speaker and speak Standard American English. There are different varieties of spoken English in the US, and if anything, I may speak a "Western" variety of American English since I have spent most of my life on the West Coast. This means I don't make any difference between "cot" and "caught", for example. I studied Clinical Phonetics in speech language pathology and know IPA (the International Phonetic Alphabet). I also may try to relate American English sounds to those in other languages I have studied (French, Japanese, Italian, Chinese, German). 

Although a one-hour lesson is offered, it's not necessarily recommended to take a one-hour pronunciation lesson as it will be fairly tiring. You're welcome to try 30 minutes and see if this lesson is for you. Audio recordings of lessons may be available for review and study if desired, depending on the platform you choose.

By the way, 1 hour lessons can be on italki classroom or Skype. Lessons on Zoom cannot last longer than 40 min.

Homework is only available for students who book lessons of at least one hour.

pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to sound better, and also improve your LISTENING comprehension dramatically? Well, the way you speak is the way you expect to hear. Better listening comprehension means you can enjoy learning using radio, TV and movies — enjoying all the benefits of authentic native-speaker material.

This course can be taken at any time, but it is most advantageous to do so before memorizing thousands of words with inaccurate pronunciation, and before spending countless hours practicing bad prosody in conversations.

No, you will not be able to pass for a native speaker after just one session :) The goal of this course will be to aim for near-native pronunciation while we make steady progress each lesson. Language coaching is provided so you can maximize your self-study outside of our sessions.

My philosophy: You do not need “accent reduction” — you do not need to reduce anything. Your native accent is perfect — for your native language. What you need is accent acquisition — to acquire a subconscious mastery of the characteristic phonology of your target language that will allow you to speak “naturally” and LISTEN as easily as a native.

Depending on your personal goals and what we uncover during our first conversation, we may perfect your consonants, vowels, stress, intonation, rhythm, etc. We can improve all of these at either a basic or advanced level, as needed.

Video or just audio — it’s your decision, as I can tell exactly how you’re using your lips, tongue, etc., just by listening.

The price of this course is a little bit higher than the standard “Conversational English with Integrated Grammar” because 99.9% of English teachers don’t have the skills to teach it. You will experience noticeable improvement after every session — guaranteed. Write me for additional information.

pro_course_detail.description:

pro_course_detail.title: English Language Through Literature
pro_course_detail.description:
The heart of any language is in its literature. 

There, the ideas, the stories, and the unique turns-of-phrase and rhythms that built the modern spoken language lay waiting to be discovered. These great works give us a world to enter, to participate in, and ultimately to bring into ourselves. They lend themselves to a deeper understanding of the target language and allow us to build a more personal relationship with it. 

The advantages of a literary education are not only aesthetic but, above all, practical. A knowledge of literature exposes the student to a much wider and more powerful range of vocabulary than most conversational courses, while also teaching higher level grammar and syntax, greater comprehension, an ear for eloquence, and important cultural allusions. 

For this type of lesson, you are free to select any classic work of literature, poetry, philosophy, politics, etc. and I will read it with you chapter by chapter, and build lessons based upon your desired outcome. We can spend time on vocabulary, discussing or debating critical themes, or any aspect of your choice. I can also take the lead and offer a general English language literature course, or general assistance in understanding a literary work (a holistic approach). 

This course may appeal especially to college students who are struggling through a difficult English language text, though, this is truly for everyone who wants to deepen and broaden their knowledge of English, and perhaps—just perhaps—learn to enjoy the fruits of their labor.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
One of the best ways to learn a language is through conversation.  We can talk about everyday life or any topics that interest you.  Don't know what to talk about? No problem! We can use conversation cards with random topics, or we can play fun games that promote conversation. 

Do you like homework?  Me too!  Your time is valuable, and homework helps you get the most out of class time. I enjoy sending a short article or video before each class.  You can choose a topic that you are interested in, or I can choose the topic. Then I will bring some interesting discussion questions to class so we will always have something unique to talk about.  The homework is always optional, but it helps you get the most out of our time together.

This is a relaxed type of class. Mistakes are a part of the learning process and allow us to grow. 
I encourage you to take risks, make mistakes, and enjoy the process. Throughout the class, I will take notes on a shared Google Doc with suggestions to help you sound more like a native speaker, as well as new words and phrases.  This way, you can review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for a structured plan that will take you to the next level? Then this class is for you! This course follows a logical sequence. First we will learn new vocabulary words, practice seeing them in context, then practice using them out loud.  We will also cover all the grammar points necessary in order to master the English language.

Since these are private lessons, they are 100% customized to your needs.  Not sure when to use the past perfect? Then we can start with the past perfect.  Or would you rather focus on vocabulary related to business?  You're the boss.  During your first lesson, we will create a learning plan to help you accomplish your goals. But if you're not sure where to start, I can do a short assessment of your current level, and help you decide where to begin.  

This course typically involves reading, writing, speaking, and listening exercises. In order to get the most out of your class time, most of the reading, writing, and listening exercises are given as homework.  This way, we can spend more time speaking during class.  And of course, we will focus more on the skills that are most relevant to your goals.

pro_course_detail.title: TOEFL, IELTS, CAE, and Duolingo Test Prep
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to help you achieve the best score possible on whichever English proficiency exam you are preparing for.  Using practice exams as a guide, we will pinpoint any weaknesses and fine-tune them.

Before the first class, please send me a message informing me which exam you will be taking and the exam date. This way, we can create a study plan that is specific to your needs. If your exam date is soon, we can get down to business by practicing the speaking portion of the exam, linking words, and exam tips. teacher_info.about_teacher:
I've been teaching pronunciation for the past 7 years, and I honestly don't have a singular conceptual philosophy to sell you on. However, I know a lot about pronunciation and accents, and without a doubt, I can help you with yours.
As a good accent coach and instructor, it's my job to comprehend and process all the little details that go into the vocal production of the American accent; and to provide you with what's most important for the improvement of your own accent. Presenting it all to you in an easily digestible way. 
That's essentially what I do.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
1) I'll listen to your pronunciation as we talk. Believe it or not, this is the BEST way to diagnose what's going on with your accent. If we want to fix your accent for use in real-life conversations, then we need to diagnose your accent issues, within a real conversation.  

2) We'll work together on the most glaring issues in your accent. If you can't make the sound, I'll help you to produce it. 

3) Once the sound is produceable, we'll use repetition of it within sentences, to get it into your muscle memory. Repetition is crucial for muscle memory retention. We'll also shadow (mimic) native speakers in series, movies and podcasts. I'll be giving you continual feedback as we progress.

pro_course_detail.title: American Pronunciation & Accent Coaching
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn how to speak with the North American accent.
Pronunciation is not only about individual sounds, it also involves intonation and Word Groups: Groups of words that flow together. This is a key aspect to North American pronunciation. We are a mumbling people. Our language is casual, and it flows. As a non-native, you're used to separating almost every word, using strong consonant sounds. In music theory that's called 'staccato'. But it's very un-American to speak that way. I will teach you how to modify sounds in order to create the American flow in your own speech.

You'll learn all about American speech patterns, intonation, tongue positioning, voice placement, breath, shadowing; stop consonants, vowel reductions, word linking, function/content words, the schwa, which sounds Americans erase--and when, the Flap T, pitch and syllable stress, voiced vs. unvoiced, and more.  

You can continue on with me as your accent coach, or take the self-practice I teach you, and improve on your own. But with the matrials and knowledge I provide, the choice will be yours.

Shadowing is a well-known practice in the world of pronunciation and accent learning. And while I include it as part of my American Accent class, the Shadowing class is entirely focused on the practice of shadowing.

Shadowing is essentially mimicking a native speaker of your target accent. In this class, we would be mimicking Americans in series, movies, and YouTube videos. I'll lead you through the process, show you ways with which you'll get the most out of it, and give you feedback as we go. 

Shadowing can completely transform peoples' accents, when practiced frequently. And does so by tapping into our intuition, of what feels right and wrong, based on our experience mimicking natives.

Whether you aim to spend some time in a German-speaking country, learn something new, or one day speak German to family, friends, and loved ones, we will work to develop your ability to express yourself and understand spoken and written German for use in everyday life. 

Students will be assigned light homework exercises to review vocabulary and structures covered in class before the next lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Lesestunde: German Reading and Writing (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In order to improve your reading and writing skills we will practise different reading techniques and strategies and look at writing as a process. During our German lessons we will read an interesting text - at times aloud, at times individually - before completing exercises that will help to strengthen your understanding of the text and expand your vocabulary. You will learn how to avoid writing mistakes and how to successfully structure and edit your own writing so that is easily readable. 
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free German, but rather to strive towards an understandable use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.
 
Um Ihre Lese- und Schreibfertigkeiten zu verbessern werden wir zusammen unterschiedliche Lesetechniken und -strategien üben und das Schreiben als Prozess betrachten. Während der Deutschstunde lesen wir mal vor, mal als Einzelarbeit, und erledigen Aufgaben, die Ihr Verständnis des Textes verfestigen und ihren Wortschatz erweitern sollen. Sie werden lernen wie man Schreibfehler vermeiden kann und einen gut lesbaren Text erfolgreich aufbaut und bearbeitet. 
 
Wir streben nicht nach Perfektion oder fehlerfreiem Deutsch, sondern nach einer verständlichen Sprache in Wort und Schrift und mehr Freude am Lesen.

pro_course_detail.title: Book Club: Reading and Writing in English (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course you will improve your use of English by reading, discussing, and writing about thought-provoking essays, interviews, articles, and stories of various lengths and types. We will practise reading aloud and individually during our English lessons, although at times you may be asked to read a chapter or medium-length short story at home to prepare for our discussion in the next lesson. We will look at different strategies for using a text to learn new vocabulary, complete comprehension exercises in order to strengthen your understanding of key ideas in the text, and learn to structure and edit your own stories, essays and written responses.
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free English, but rather to strive towards an effective use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Exploring the Canon: A Light Reading of English Classics (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you’ve ever wanted to tackle Beowulf or a Shakespearean play in a stress-free, non-academic setting, this course is for you!

In this course we will read and discuss a handful of English-language texts that have served as the inspiration for art, poetry, drama, and film from their conception to the modern day. We will take a look at both historical and modern works, including plays, short stories, essays and longer works, some of which may be adapted for the modern reader. Although our discussions and activities will be loosely structured on key themes and elements of style in the texts, students are encouraged to bring their own discussion questions and ideas to class.

A modest, manageable amount of at-home reading may be assigned depending on the work we are covering. Students are advised to take their time with the material and wait to book the next lesson until they have completed the reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Individually Customised Lessons in German (A1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
This class option is ideal for German learners at all levels who are:

+ preparing for an upcoming unit test/quiz in your German class at a (language) school or university
+ at risk of failing a German class and need additional support
+ self-learners with various questions about the language and/or would like structured practice on a specific grammatical topic

We can schedule a specialised one-time session or package deal in order to clarify, review, and practise using the grammatical structures and vocabulary that you find difficult. If you would like regularly-scheduled, personally customised lessons for a reason other than those mentioned above, please send me a message about what you would like to focus on specifically and we can see about developing the proper course of action to realise your language learning goals.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Speaking
pro_course_detail.description: In this course you will be provided with interesting videos, articles or other learning materials to watch or read at home before the next lesson. We will then discuss the materials together, learn and practise using interesting vocabulary found in each resource, and expand your ability to speak on a variety of different topics.

pro_course_detail.title: Intensive English Grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course you will learn about the rules of English grammar in speech and writing. You will learn how to structure simple and complex sentences, tell stories using the narrative tenses, effectively use modal verbs and improve your use of conditionals, continuous forms and prepositions. 

Students will be provided with digital learning materials for class and assigned homework exercises to review grammatical structures and concepts before the next lesson.
